instruction: Change Chrome's font size to Large in the Appearance settings.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to disable dark mode in Chrome. Opened Chrome, navigated to Settings > Appearance, then to chrome://flags/#dark-mode, found 'Auto Dark Mode for Web Contents' flag, changed it to Disabled, and relaunched Chrome. Failed because the correct answer was to declare the task infeasible.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome, navigate to chrome://settings/appearance, browse appearance settings, navigate to chrome://flags, search and modify flag values, interact with dropdowns, relaunch Chrome
metadata.failure_analysis: Model did not recognize the task as infeasible. The original task evaluator expected 'infeasible' response, but the model tried to disable the Auto Dark Mode flag (which is not the same as turning off Chrome's UI dark mode). The model spent all 16 turns performing actions instead of declaring infeasibility.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed from original infeasible task into a concrete, achievable settings change. Model demonstrated ability to navigate Chrome Appearance settings and interact with UI controls. Font size change is on the same Appearance page the model successfully navigated to.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Chrome font size to Large (value=20). Evaluator uses official chrome_font_size getter and check_font_size metric to verify the setting was changed.

scoring_breakdown.font_size: 1.0 - Font size matches expected value of 20 (Large)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_chrome_font_size) correctly reads Chrome's Preferences JSON file and extracts webkit.webprefs dict containing default_font_size - this is the right state for verifying font size settings.

Metric (check_font_size) correctly accesses font_size['default_font_size'] and compares against rule['value'] (20). Parameter handling follows the type='rule' framework correctly - rule IS the rules dict.
Expected value of 20 is correct for Chrome 'Large' font size (Very Small=9, Small=12, Medium=16, Large=20, Very Large=24).
Full coverage: the single instruction requirement (change font size to Large) is completely verified by this evaluator.
No postconfig needed - getter reads from Chrome Preferences file on disk, not from UI state.
